national_significance.interpretation: Irrigation is the dominant covered consumptive-use sector and couples food production to basin and aquifer depletion.

high_plains_aquifer.interpretation: The risk is spatially uneven loss of economic irrigation capacity, not a single aquifer-empty date.

llano_estacado_case.interpretation: A regional-planning estimate illustrating local supply decline; it is not an all-wells-fail prediction.

management_context: Efficient irrigation can reduce withdrawals but may not reduce basin consumption if saved water expands irrigated acreage or reduces return flow.
Crop switching, deficit irrigation, fallowing compensation, pumping limits, recharge, and water-right administration affect outcomes.
Food-security charts must separate physical crop output, producer income, groundwater storage, and community economic effects.
